drift_window_loader_relevant_changelog.entry: Added --no-context-files to start a session without AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or other context files, including --add-dir roots and in subagents
Fixed task subagents receiving AGENTS.md files, including the user-level ~/.omp/agent/AGENTS.md, when the session has additional workspace roots
Breaking: custom tool loaders now resolve the injected host SDK themselves; constructors take cwd as first argument instead of a pi namespace
Added optional task-file input (task.file=true): subagent instructions loaded from an absolute UTF-8 file path or local:// URL with submitted path and SHA-256 recorded
Fixed the managed-skills root guard rejecting a symlinked store outright; a root resolving to a directory now accepts writes inside its target
